title: Structure tests around observable behavior and isolated repositories
statement: Name tests for observable behavior, arrange only the state the behavior needs, assert the persisted or returned contract, pass the test cancellation token, and isolate filesystem fixtures with cleanup.
rationale: Quality Studio is file-first and Git-aware. Behavior-focused tests using temporary repository roots catch contract regressions without depending on machine state or test order.

examples.bad: [Fact] public async Task Test1() { await service.RunAsync(); Assert.True(true); }

history.change: Initial .NET test-structure seed grounded in Quality Studio's xUnit repository fixtures.
